headline: Approved liquor license renewals and outside consumption permits for local businesses
summary: The commission adopted a consent agenda approving 2026-2027 liquor license renewals and an outside consumption permit expansion for Pascolo Ristorante. It also approved a new outside consumption permit application for Alimentari.
decisions: Adopted the consent agenda, approving liquor license renewals and the Pascolo Ristorante permit expansion
Approved the 2026-2027 Outside Consumption Permit Application for Alimentari, 196 St. Paul Street

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Commissioner Schachter, seconded by Commissioner Grant, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
Motion made by Commissioner Grant, seconded by Commissioner Singh, to approve the motion as presented. Motion passed unanimously.
